title: Phase-aware upgrade orchestrator for VPC data plane with staged priming and evacuation
creator: Lena Chen
description: Goal: build a phase-aware upgrade orchestrator for Private/VPC data planes that performs rolling upgrades with zero-customer-downtime guarantees. The operator will use declarative IaC hooks (Terraform module outputs and lifecycle hooks), preflight validation, staged priming (KV/cache warmup), connection evacuation, and health-quorum checks to safely advance phases. It must integrate with existing Private runtime agents and the control plane, emit observable signals for Console dashboards, and support automated rollback on health regression. This ticket covers design, Terraform module extensions, runtime health gating, and the first end-to-end proof-of-concept on a canary tenant slice.
acceptance_criteria: Operator can perform a 3-phase rolling upgrade across a 10-node tenant slice without dropping in-flight requests (verified by synthetic trace sampling)
Terraform module exposes lifecycle hooks (pre_update, post_update, abort_on_fail) and the operator consumes outputs to sequence changes
Priming step successfully preloads KV caches for new runtime instances with >95% warm-hit rate before traffic shifts
Automatic rollback triggers when health-quorum fails for >2 consecutive probes and returns to pre-upgrade version within configured timeout
Console shows per-tenant rollout progress, per-host health timeline, and a clear rollback button that ties to operator actions
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Preflight: validate IaC plan (terraform plan) against control-plane constraints, verify snapshots and backups, run canary smoke tests against staging
Phase 1 - Provision & Priming: create new runtime instances in VPC, run priming agent to load hot KV prefixes and sequence-length-specific kernels, verify cache warm metrics

Phase 2 - Evacuate & Shift Small %: mark subset of hosts as candidate for traffic, shift 5% traffic via smart-router with session affinity disabled for new connections, monitor latency and error budgets for 10m
Phase 3 - Progressive Shift: increase traffic 5x every 10m if health gates pass, keep legacy instances in draining mode until session counts reach zero, maintain KV shard reconciliation
Phase 4 - Finalize: decommission legacy instances once primed hosts reach steady-state, snapshot telemetry and mark rollout complete
rollback_plan: Immediate safety abort: operator holds progress and returns routing to last known-good targets if health_quorum fails
Automated rollback: reapply terraform to re-create previous runtime version using pinned AMIs/containers and reattach saved KV snapshots
Graceful drain: new candidates are removed from routing and existing connections are allowed to finish; if unsafe, force-terminate after configurable grace period
Post-rollback verification: run synthetic end-to-end tests and compare request traces to baseline to ensure parity
health_checks: Liveness probes: runtime responds to /healthz with readiness and priming progress (keys loaded / total keys)
Performance probes: p95 latency and token generation time measured on synthetic requests representative of customer workloads
Cache health: warm-hit ratio and steady-state eviction rate over 5m window
Session consistency: active session count delta during shift and KV sync lag under 500ms
Quorum policy: require 80% of hosts in target slice to pass all probes for 3 consecutive intervals before advancing phase
terraform_changes: Add lifecycle hook outputs: module.private_runtime now emits pre_update_sns_topic, priming_init_lambda_arn, and rollback_plan_id
Introduce resource tags for phased updates: runtime.phase and runtime.rollout_id to allow operator filtering
Create tfdata resource for snapshotting KV metadata before changes and provide a restore endpoint consumed by operator
Provide an optional count-based instance template to allow deterministic replacement order for host-level priming
observability_changes: Expose rollout timeline events to Console (rollout.start, rollout.phase_change, rollout.abort, rollout.complete) via ControlPlaneEvents stream
Instrument per-tenant rollout metrics: priming_hit_rate, phase_duration_seconds, rollback_initiated, hosts_draining_count
Add tracing spans for operator actions (terraform.apply, priming.run, router.shift) and surface in Console trace explorer
Create an alert rule: critical if phase stuck >30m or rollback rate >0.5 within 1h
notes: This design intentionally separates priming from traffic shift to minimize cold-start risk. We must validate cross-tenant KV keyspace isolation before broad rollout. Work will proceed in two sprints: design + proto (this ticket) and hardening + infra rollout (follow-up). Expect collaboration with networking to ensure the smart-router can accept fine-grained weight updates via the new rollout API.
